name: cceps
expr: y = cceps(x); [d8, nd8] = cceps(x); z = cceps(w); [dw, ndw] = cceps(w);
comment: Sig: [xhat, nd] = cceps(x). Complex cepstrum real(ifft(log|fft x| + i*rcunwrap(angle(fft x)))). FORWARD fft uses dir=-1, the inverse pass dir=+1 (using +1 for both time-reverses the output). Phase: full unwrap + MATLAB rcunwrap linear-phase removal (subtract pi*nd*(0:n-1)/fix((n+1)/2)), with nd = round(unwrapped(nh+1)/pi) the (circular) delay = 2nd output. Fixes bugs/signal/cceps-nd-phase (non-power-of-two phase was garbage past DC; nd was missing). Verified vs MATLAB R2025b: power-of-two (1:8) and non-2^n [1 2 3 4 3 2 1] both bit-identical, nd8=1, ndw=-3. Octave's phase-unwrap path differs; harness prefers MATLAB.
